faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Kallakurichi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the DCPU Kallakurichi Recruitment 2026 is 28th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the DCPU Kallakurichi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the DCPU Kallakurichi Recruitment 2026. These vacancies are for the posts of Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk and Office Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk position, candidates must have passed the SSLC (Class 10) public examination or its equivalent. Proficiency in computers is mandatory, and preference will be given to those with a typing certificate in Tamil and English.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Office Assistant post, candidates must have passed the VIII (Class 8) examination from any recognized State or Private School Board. This is the minimum educational requirement for this role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts under the DCPU Kallakurichi Recruitment 2026 is 42 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this age criterion at the time of application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Assistant Cum Record Clerk post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/-. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Office Assistant post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 13,000/-. This is also a contractual position.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the DCPU Kallakurichi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates in the DCPU Kallakurichi Recruitment 2026. Both General/OBC and SC/ST candidates are exempt from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the DCPU Kallakurichi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DCPU Kallakurichi Recruitment 2026 involves two main stages: Application Scrutiny and Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on the scrutiny of their applications and then called for document verification.

faq.answer: The application process for DCPU Kallakurichi Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out carefully, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address specified in the notification before the last date.
